description: This file defines an AuthRepository class responsible for managing user authentication state locally using SharedPreferences. It provides methods for retrieving the current user, logging in, logging out, and updating KYC completion status, with data stored as encoded User objects.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: A class that provides mock local authentication with persistent storage, allowing to get current user, login, logout, and update user KYC status.

methods.name: AuthRepository
methods.description: Constructor initializing AuthRepository with SharedPreferences instance.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Fetches the current user from local storage, decoding it from a string if present.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Creates a new User with provided email and displayName, assigns a UUID, marks KYC as incomplete, saves it to storage, and returns the user.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Removes the user data from local storage.

methods.name: setKycCompleted
methods.description: Updates the current user's KYC status, saves the updated user back to storage, and returns the updated user.
